notes: Episode of Coke Studio Bangla Season 1 (aired 7 Feb–1 Sep 2022) pairing vocalist Nigar Sumi with hip-hop group Jalali Set on 'Bhober Pagol,' a track fusing hip-hop/trap with traditional Bangladeshi folk instrumentation (dotara, ektara). Represents a produced broadcast/streaming performance rather than a ticketed live-audience concert; included here to capture the platform's role in cross-genre collaboration documented in data/genres/genre-overview.md. Nigar Sumi is not yet catalogued as an artist in this dataset.
